Review the [v0.2.1 candidate protocol](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/blob/main/captures/2026-10-11T014149Z-codex-memory-seat-b7043e45/PROTOCOL_v0.2.1_CANDIDATE.md), [source input contract](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/blob/main/captures/2026-10-11T015458Z-codex-source-bridge-8e19b473/INPUT_CONTRACT_v0.1_CANDIDATE.md), [original guard census](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/blob/main/captures/2026-10-11T014149Z-codex-memory-seat-b7043e45/guard_replay.py), and [new frame-alignment audit](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/blob/main/captures/2026-10-11-codex-op03-frame-alignment-v01/OP03_FRAME_ALIGNMENT_VALIDATOR_NOTE_v0.1.md). The last note finds an implementation hazard, not a counterexample to the protocol's aligned-state formula.

## Requested review return
- Declare identity, non-construction status, involvement and conflicts; cite the exact source commits/versions reviewed.
- Challenge exact 12D-to-6D block/frame certification, coordinate-seat rank/support and independent receipt provenance, noncoordinate holds, integrity and collision cases.
- Recompute the toggle from `bar(theta)^- = P_pi(r) theta^-` in output coordinates, including frame-only null windows, zero-index swaps, first-switch indexing and coverage. Attempt a minimal counterexample; check that no endpoint or target-derived seat enters a pre-event field.
- State which claims pass, fail or remain source-blocked with proof/calculation or reproducible code. Preserve narrower valid algebra if a constitutive or predictive claim fails.

The constructor-side 13,824-case census and 1,296-case frame-alignment audit do not satisfy this review. Any proposed CRL promotion also requires a separate custodian ruling; a review alone does not promote a physical correspondence.

## Scope
An independently governed producer is needed to test the OP03 v0.2 receipt-index and v0.2.1 seat/no-op candidate on a fresh, same-carrier cohort. This is an open call; no producer has accepted. Physical promotion remains 0.

Read the [full handoff v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/blob/main/captures/2026-10-11T020241Z-codex-op03-producer-handoff-23f7e091/PROVIDER_HANDOFF_v0.1.md) and [source input contract v0.1](https://github.com/ud-tetra/UD/blob/main/captures/2026-10-11T015458Z-codex-source-bridge-8e19b473/INPUT_CONTRACT_v0.1_CANDIDATE.md). The directory's `120000Z` component is a staging identifier, not a custody timestamp; see its `CAPTURE_TIME_NOTE.md`.

## Producer acceptance and return
- Declare independent authorship, producer and separate target custodian, conflict/prior involvement, engine or measurement specification and code hash before acquisition.
- Predeclare the complete window interval, all candidate and null windows, prior completed Θ index, frame route, eligibility/exclusions, source and endpoint clocks, and source/target seal chronology.
- Seal source-complete oriented C1 or observed/co-moving 12D transfers; raw/prealigned Θ, lineage, continuation/source/renewal, viable seat and integrity receipts, burden and source arithmetic before any endpoint access.
- Keep independently observed full relative S4 frame and full three-bit Θ endpoint for the same windows hidden until the prediction stream is sealed and hashed.
- Return a typed missing-field hold when a required source is unavailable. Do not publish hidden targets in this issue before the prediction-hash barrier.

Synthetic selector-generated series and the one-pair Xi bench do not qualify as full OP03 endpoints. A feasibility report documenting why independent source or endpoint acquisition cannot be done is also a useful return. No predictions have been scored.
